title: payment.authorized.v1
description: Funds were held. Published by Payment Orchestration (BC-6) on pp.payments.payment.v1, keyed by payment_id. The attempt named here is the one holding the payment's single successful-terminal slot, which a partial unique index enforces at the database level - that constraint is what makes double-charging structurally impossible rather than merely unlikely.

authorizedAmount.description: May be LESS than the payment amount for a partial authorization, which is why it is carried rather than assumed equal.

gatewayReference.description: The gateway's transaction identifier. Needed for capture, void and reconciliation, so it must survive into the event and not only into the attempt row.

authorizationExpiresAt.description: Drives the auth-expiry sweeper. An authorization that expires uncaptured is revenue lost silently unless something is watching this field.

threeDsStatus.description: Strong customer authentication outcome. Exemptions are modelled explicitly and audited: claiming one is a decision the platform must be able to defend to a regulator, so it is never implicit.

networkTransactionId.description: Scheme reference chaining later merchant-initiated transactions to this cardholder-initiated authorization.
